## Tutors Project Architecture Report

### 1. Framework

**SvelteKit** (Svelte 5) with Vite.

- `D:\code\tutors\svelte.config.js` -- SvelteKit configuration using `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` and `vitePreprocess()`
- `D:\code\tutors\vite.config.ts` -- Vite config with the `sveltekit()` plugin
- `D:\code\tutors\package.json` -- Version 15.2.0, using `@sveltejs/kit ^2.64.0`, `svelte ^5.56.3`, Tailwind CSS 4, and Skeleton UI v4 (`@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte ^4.15.2`)
- Uses Svelte 5 runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$props`) throughout

### 2. Markdown Rendering Pipeline

The markdown rendering is handled by **markdown-it**, configured in the external `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` package (published on JSR).

**Core markdown engine** -- `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\utils\markdown-utils.ts`:

```typescript
export const markdownIt: MarkdownIt = new MarkdownIt({
  html: true,
  typographer: true,
  highlight: function (str: string, lang: string) {
    // Uses Shiki (via a custom highlighter injected at runtime)
    return customHighlighter?.codeToHtml(str, { lang, theme: currentTheme, transformers: [addCopyButton(options)] });
  },
});
```

**Plugins loaded on the markdown-it instance** (all in that same file):
- `@iktakahiro/markdown-it-katex` -- LaTeX math rendering
- `markdown-it-anchor` -- header anchors with permalink links
- `markdown-it-table-of-contents` -- auto-generated TOC (levels 1-3)
- `markdown-it-emoji` -- emoji support (full set)
- `markdown-it-sub` -- subscript
- `markdown-it-sup` -- superscript
- `markdown-it-mark` -- highlight/mark
- `markdown-it-footnote` -- footnotes
- `markdown-it-deflist` -- definition lists
- Custom `videoPlayer` plugin -- `::video[src='...' ...]::` syntax for inline video embeds (YouTube iframes or HTML5 video)
- Custom `podcastPlayer` plugin -- `::podcast[src='...' ...]::` syntax for Spotify podcast embeds
- Custom `blockquote_open`/`blockquote_close` renderers -- styled blockquotes
- Custom `link_open` renderer -- external links open in new tab

These custom plugins are defined in `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\utils\markdown-plugins.js`.

**Syntax highlighting** uses **Shiki** (not Prism). The Shiki highlighter is created synchronously in the SvelteKit app at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\markdown\services\markdown.svelte.ts` with 30+ language grammars and 7 color themes, then injected into the model library via `initHighlighter(shiki)`. The `@shikijs/markdown-it` package is listed as a devDependency but the actual integration is done manually through the `highlight` option in markdown-it configuration.

**Key function**: `convertMdToHtml(md, codeTheme)` -- the single entry point that calls `markdownIt.render(md)`.

**Content pipeline flow**:
1. Course JSON is fetched from a remote URL (e.g., `https://{courseUrl}/tutors.json`)
2. The JSON is parsed into a `Course` tree of learning objects
3. `decorateCourseTree()` in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\lo-tree.ts` walks the tree and calls `convertLoToHtml()` for non-lab, non-note, non-notebook types immediately
4. Labs, notes, and notebooks are converted on-demand (lazy) via the `markdownService` in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\markdown\services\markdown.svelte.ts`
5. A `filter()` function rewrites relative image/archive URLs to absolute URLs before rendering
6. HTML output is injected into Svelte components via `{@html lo.contentHtml}` inside `<article class="prose dark:prose-invert">` wrappers (using Tailwind Typography)

### 3. Course Materials / Content Structure

**Content types** are defined in `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\types\learning-objects.ts`:

**Simple types** (`simpleTypes` array in `type-utils.ts`):
- `note` -- markdown document (Note type)
- `lab` -- multi-step lab with ordered steps (Lab type, contains `LabStep[]`)
- `talk` -- presentation/lecture, renders a PDF (Talk type, has `pdf` field)
- `paneltalk` -- panel-style talk (PanelTalk, extends Talk)
- `tutorial` -- simple text content with optional PDF
- `archive` -- downloadable content
- `web` -- external web link
- `github` -- GitHub repository link
- `panelnote` -- panel-style note
- `panelvideo` -- panel-style video
- `podcast` -- Spotify podcast episode (has `episode` with ID)
- `book` -- (referenced in simpleTypes but no explicit type definition found)

**Composite types** (`loCompositeTypes`):
- `course` -- top-level container, has `topicIndex`, `loIndex`, `wallMap`, properties, enrollment, calendar
- `topic` -- groups related content
- `unit` -- major course section
- `side` -- supplementary content

Each composite type extends `Composite`, which has `toc`, `los`, `panels` (panelVideos, panelTalks, panelNotes, panelPodcasts), and `units` (units, sides, standardLos).

**Content loading** -- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\course.svelte.ts`:
- `getOrLoadCourse()` fetches `tutors.json` from the course URL and caches it
- `readLab()` converts lab markdown to HTML on first access, wraps it in a `LiveLab` instance
- `readLo()` converts notes and notebooks on first access
- `refreshAllLabs()` re-renders all cached labs/notes/notebooks (e.g., on theme change)

**Route structure** -- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\`:
- `/course/[courseid]` -- course overview
- `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- lab viewer with step navigation
- `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- note viewer
- `/notebook/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Jupyter notebook viewer
- `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- PDF talk/presentation viewer
- `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- panel talk viewer
- `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- topic viewer
- `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- tutorial viewer
- `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- video viewer
- `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` -- wall view (all LOs of a type)
- `/search/[courseid]` -- search
- `/time/[courseid]` -- analytics/time tracking
- `/llm/[courseid]` -- LLM-friendly text export

### 4. Presentation/Slide Support

There is **no dedicated slide/presentation/Marp support**. The word "slide" in the codebase refers only to:
- Svelte `slide` transition for UI animations (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\TutorsShell.svelte`)
- `slideFromLeft`/`slideFromRight` animation helpers (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\animations.ts`)
- The "presentation-chart-bar" icon used for `talk` and `paneltalk` types (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\hero-icons.ts`)

**Talks/presentations are rendered as PDFs**, not as slide decks. The PDF rendering uses two backends:
- **Adobe PDF Embed API** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkAdobe.svelte`) -- default
- **Mozilla pdf.js** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkMozilla.svelte`) -- alternative, canvas-based

The choice is controlled by the `defaultPdfReader` property on the Course object.

There is **no Marp, reveal.js, or any markdown-to-slides pipeline**.

### 5. Diagram/Chart Rendering Support (Mermaid, etc.)

There is **no mermaid, diagram, or chart rendering support** in the codebase. A grep for "mermaid" across the entire `src` directory returned zero results. The `node_modules/@tutors/tutors-model-lib` also contains no references to mermaid, diagrams, charts, or any similar libraries.

The only visualization-related libraries present are:
- **jheat.js** (`^5.2.0` in `package.json`) -- used for calendar heatmaps in the time/analytics views
- **KaTeX** -- for LaTeX math rendering (via CDN stylesheet in Lab, Note, and Notebook components)

### 6. Monorepo Structure

This is **not a monorepo**. It is a single SvelteKit application with no workspaces. There is only one `package.json` at the root level (no `packages/` or `apps/` directories, no workspace configuration in package.json).

- `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` (`npm:@jsr/tutors__tutors-time-lib@^5.0.3`) -- time tracking / analytics

**Project directory layout**:
```
D:\code\tutors\
  src\
    lib\
      runes.svelte.ts          -- global reactive state (Svelte 5 runes)
      services\
        markdown\              -- markdown rendering service wrapper

        connect\               -- auth, user profiles
        themes\                -- theming, icons, card styles, festive events

        TutorsShell.svelte     -- main app shell
        learning-objects\
          content\             -- Lab, Note, Notebook, Talk*, Video, Podcast, Calendar
          layout\              -- Card, Cards, Panels, Units, Wall
          structure\           -- Context, Composite, CourseContext, LoContext
        navigators\            -- navigation components, animations
        components\            -- shared UI components
        time\                  -- time/analytics UI
    routes\
      (auth)\                  -- authentication pages
      (course-reader)\         -- main course content routes
      (home)\                  -- landing page
      (live)\                  -- live/catalogue views
```

This is **not a monorepo**. It is a single SvelteKit application with no workspaces. There is only one `package.json` at the root level (no `packages/` or `apps/` directories, no workspace configuration in package.json).

The project depends on two external packages published separately on JSR (JavaScript Registry):
- `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (`npm:@jsr/tutors__tutors-model-lib@^5.0.0`) -- contains types, markdown processing, course utilities, learning object tree logic, and search
- `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` (`npm:@jsr/tutors__tutors-time-lib@^5.0.3`) -- time tracking / analytics

**Project directory layout**:
```
D:\code\tutors\
  src\
    lib\
      runes.svelte.ts          -- global reactive state (Svelte 5 runes)
      services\
        markdown\              -- markdown rendering service wrapper
        course\                -- course loading, caching, live lab management
        community\             -- analytics, catalogue, live presence (Supabase)
        connect\               -- auth, user profiles
        themes\                -- theming, icons, card styles, festive events
      ui\
        TutorsShell.svelte     -- main app shell
        learning-objects\
          content\             -- Lab, Note, Notebook, Talk*, Video, Podcast, Calendar
          layout\              -- Card, Cards, Panels, Units, Wall
          structure\           -- Context, Composite, CourseContext, LoContext
        navigators\            -- navigation components, animations
        components\            -- shared UI components
        time\                  -- time/analytics UI
    routes\
      (auth)\                  -- authentication pages
      (course-reader)\         -- main course content routes
      (home)\                  -- landing page
      (live)\                  -- live/catalogue views
```
